argv:
set -e; echo @@boot; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; echo @@uname; uname -a; echo @@cmdline; cat /proc/cmdline; echo @@uptime; cat /proc/uptime; echo @@identity; zcat /proc/config.gz | sha256sum; sha256sum /sys/kernel/notes; echo @@battery; cat /sys/class/power_supply/sm5714-battery/uevent; echo @@usb; cat /sys/class/power_supply/sm5714-usb/uevent; echo @@passive; cat /sys/class/power_supply/sm5440-passive/uevent; echo @@snapshot; cat /sys/kernel/debug/sm5440-0-0063/snapshot; echo @@network; ip -4 -o addr; echo @@services; systemctl is-active ssh gts9-adbd gts9-usb-acm || true; echo @@roles; cat /sys/class/typec/port0/power_role /sys/class/typec/port0/data_role; echo @@failed; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain --no-pager; echo @@dcc; if test ! -e /dev/hvc0 && test ! -e /sys/class/tty/hvc0 && ! systemctl is-active --quiet serial-getty@hvc0.service; then echo absent; else echo present; fi; echo @@host-key; cat /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub; echo @@tcpm; set -- /sys/class/power_supply/tcpm-source-psy-*/uevent; test "$#" = 1; cat "$1"; echo @@boot-end; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo @@pack-thermal
pack=
for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do
 if test "$(cat "$z/type")" = sm5714-battery; then test -z "$pack"; pack=$z; fi
done
test -n "$pack"; cat "$pack/type" "$pack/mode" "$pack/temp"
echo @@source
cat /sys/kernel/debug/sm5714-*/current-port
echo @@oneshot
cat /sys/kernel/debug/sm5440-0-0063/oneshot
echo @@boot-end; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
